Package io.github._3xhaust.core

Class StatefulWidget

java.lang.Object
io.github._3xhaust.core.StatefulWidget
All Implemented Interfaces:
View
public abstract class StatefulWidget extends Object implements View
A widget that owns mutable state and rebuilds when setState(Runnable) is invoked. Override initState() to do one-time setup, build() to describe the UI, and dispose() to clean up resources.

Calling setState(...) schedules a rebuild on the next render frame via JavaUIApp.requestRebuild(), so listeners can chain mutations without worrying about render storms.
